body: Our gold-standard signature fusion brings together two of Kerala's most treasured therapies in a single 90-minute experience. It begins with a full-body Abhyangam using dosha-specific warm medicated oils, applied with rhythmic strokes that envelop the body in soothing warmth. This flows seamlessly into Shirodhara, where a warm stream of tailored herbal oil (tailam) is poured in a continuous pendular motion across the forehead, gently anchoring attention at the Ajna chakra.

Together, the massage and the steady oil stream guide you into an incredibly deep state of relaxation. You can expect a warm medicated oil massage, the body cradled in warm oils, and then the gentle, uniform, rhythmic pressure of the oil stream moving across the forehead. It is an intensive holistic reset designed for those carrying genuine physical and mental fatigue.
benefits: Dramatically reduces both physiological and psychological stress
Enhances lymphatic drainage and supports the body's natural detoxification
Eases chronic muscular tension and body stiffness
Resets erratic circadian rhythms to encourage deep, restorative sleep
Offers simultaneous physical and psychological detoxification
Ideal for severe burnout and generalised anxiety

Abhyangam & Sirodhaara.contraindications: This therapy is best avoided if you are experiencing acute digestive issues or indigestion (Ama), and it should not be taken immediately after meals. Please also avoid it during heavy fevers, advanced pregnancy, active menstruation, or any infectious or weeping skin outbreaks.

body: This 90-minute package is thoughtfully designed to balance the body's core neurological and peripheral stress gateways. It opens with an intensive head massage (Shiro-Abhyanga) and a deep neck and shoulder massage to release accumulated tension across the upper body.

Shirodhara then follows over the forehead, while the therapist concurrently performs Paada-Abhyanga, a foot reflexology that works the marma points of the soles. You can expect localised deep-tissue relief, a sense of mental weightlessness from the oil pour, and a grounding, sensory-anchoring foot massage, often accompanied by deep relaxation and a tendency to drift towards sleep. The hair and scalp are left saturated with nourishing oils.
benefits: Instantly eases structural tension headaches
Reduces chronic cervical and neck muscle spasms
Enhances lower-limb circulation and relieves tired feet
Calms an overactive mind and improves concentration
Nourishes the hair and scalp with medicated oils
Well suited to desk-bound professionals who spend long hours on screens

It is also unsuitable in cases of active varicose-vein inflammation in the lower legs, open wounds on the scalp or feet, or scalp dandruff or skin infection.

body: This focused one-hour session is a classical Sirodhaara using medicated tailam. Warm medicated oil is poured continuously and evenly from a set height onto the forehead, guided side to side across the frontal lobe in a wave-like rhythm, and paired with a soothing head and neck massage.

It is a highly concentrated, quiet and deeply soothing neurological experience, often bringing a complete cessation of racing thoughts. The hair and scalp are left saturated with nourishing oils, making it a treatment as restorative for the mind as it is for the senses.
benefits: Balances Vata within the nervous system
Sharpens memory and enhances focus and cognition
Eliminates psychological anxiety
Offers a long-term solution for chronic insomnia
Nourishes the hair roots and scalp
Helps quieten severe stress and panic patterns

body: This express one-hour treatment integrates the body's two terminal ends. It combines a meticulous head massage (Shiro-Abhyanga) using cooling herb-infused oils to release trapped energy from the sensory organs, with an intensive structural foot massage (Paada-Abhyanga) using a bronze bowl or hands-on marma manipulation to draw excess systemic heat downward.

Expect a crisp, dynamic yet deeply calming hands-on experience: firm acupressure on the scalp, neck and precise foot reflex points, with a mild sensation as the marma are stimulated. You are left clear-headed and physically stable, making it an ideal high-impact treatment when time is short.
benefits: Reduces systemic heat and supports Pitta stabilisation
Reduces eye strain and mental tension
Stimulates internal organs via the foot reflex channels
Moisturises dry, cracked feet
Improves circulation
Reduces muscle pain and fatigue

body: A traditional full-body Ayurvedic massage with warm herb-infused oils applied from head to toe using rhythmic, synchronised strokes. The deep friction helps the medicated oil nourish the body, flush toxins and balance the energies, making it a gentle preventative and rejuvenation therapy especially suited to seniors.

You can expect deep physical relaxation, reduced muscle stiffness and better circulation, along with a powerful moisturising effect that leaves the skin smoother, brighter and more hydrated. As with all our old-age treatments, a 15-minute consultation is required first to ensure the therapy is right for you.

body: This therapy pairs a full-body oil massage with warm muslin herbal-powder poultices (podi-kizhi), which are patted and stamped across the body. The combination of targeted pressure, therapeutic heat and herbal oils penetrates the tissues to draw out stiffness and toxins.

Expect deep, penetrating warmth, the rhythmic patting and stamping of the poultices, the earthy fragrance of traditional oils and herbs, and immediate physical relief. A 15-minute consultation is required beforehand so the treatment can be tailored to senior guests.
benefits: Relieves chronic back, neck and radiating lower-back pain
Eases joint stiffness, multiple joint pain and muscle spasms
Helps with high stress, exhaustion and insomnia
Improves circulation, skin tone and flexibility
Supports post-activity recovery

body: Known classically as Shashtika Shali Pinda Sweda, this is a deep-tissue sudation and nourishment therapy. Njavara unpolished red rice is boiled in a herbal-root decoction and pure milk, bundled into muslin kizhis, and applied in long synchronised strokes over a pre-oiled body.

It is an exceptionally warm, smooth, comforting and restorative experience with no harsh strokes, only steady, rhythmic thermal friction from the milk poultices. Over a course of sessions it builds stronger muscles and joints, making it especially valuable for seniors. A 15-minute consultation is required first.
benefits: Offers powerful cellular rejuvenation and tissue nourishment (Brimhana)
Restores joint lubrication and relieves severe muscle stiffness
Supports muscle building and stronger muscles and joints over a course
Improves circulation
Encourages deeper, more restful sleep
